name: Kite Duel
summary: A rooftop kite fighting game: cross rival strings, pull to cut them loose and keep your own string cool
about: A full-screen festival sky over old city rooftops, with layered domes and minarets, drifting clouds, wind streaks and cheering families on the roofs. You steer a gold kite; when your string crosses a rival's they lock, and you hold Pull to saw through while watching the heat meter, because pulling too long snaps your own string. Cut kites tumble away on the wind and can be caught for a bonus.
how: A demo flight plays on load; press Fly now, Fly my kite, Space or tap the sky to take over.
Steer with the mouse, by dragging a finger, or with the arrow keys or WASD.
Cross a rival string to lock them, then hold Space or the Pull button to saw and release to cool your string.
Cut the number of kites shown to clear a round; later rounds bring stronger wind and rivals that hunt your string.
Fly into a falling kite to catch it for bonus points; P or Escape pauses and R restarts.
You have three strings, your best score is saved on this device, and reduced motion calms the sway and confetti.
